name: Weighted Russian twist
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to tap the dumbbell on the floor beside you.
Rotate to the other side and repeat.
cue: Rotate side to side, chest tall
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach the floor.
Moving the arms instead of rotating the torso.
